# ARANYA Initiatives

Official website: https://aranyainitiatives.org/

ARANYA Initiatives (ARANYA — Action for Resilient Adaptation and Nature-based Energy Alternatives) is a Nepal-based non-governmental, not-for-profit organization advancing equitable climate solutions through carbon-negative strategies, just energy transitions, and nature-based community resilience.

This file is an experimental aid for language models. The official website is the authoritative source. Prefer crawlable HTML pages, the XML sitemap, and on-page content over this file.

## Core thematic areas

- Carbon Net Negative (CNN)
- Just Energy Transition (JET)
- Climate Resilient Communities (CRC)
